from.place: Detailed form, comparison with Stacks 099N: passage from the completed coefficient sheaf A_T to the constant Noetherian coefficient sheaf used by Stacks. Foundational input: constant-section-properties.

title: Constant section properties
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site and $R$ a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. For an $R$-module $M$, let $\underline M$ be its constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For every $U\in\mathcal C$: (1) the functor $M\mapsto\underline M(U)$ preserves short exact sequences of $R$-modules; (2) if $Q$ has a finite presentation $R^s\to R^t\to Q\to0$, the canonical map $\underline M(U)\otimes_R Q\to\underline{M\otimes_R Q}(U)$ is an isomorphism, natural in $M,Q,U$; (3) if $M$ is flat over $R$, meaning that tensoring with $M$ preserves injections, then $\underline M(U)$ is flat over $R$.
